description: does not flip-flop conversations updated within the same 5-minute bucket. Conversations {{A}} (slug {{A_SLUG}}) and {{B}} (slug {{B_SLUG}}) were created back to back. Call "poke" sends {{A}} the message "poke" and waits for its reply, returning "replied". Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /c/{{B_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for data-testid "message-input" to be visible. 2. Click "button[aria-label='Open conversations']". 3. ".drawer.open" is visible. 4. A ".drawer.open .conversation-title" reading exactly "{{A_SLUG}}" is visible (has_text with exact), and so is one reading exactly "{{B_SLUG}}". 5. Note the order, which lists both: eval with expect "true" of (() => { const o = [...document.querySelectorAll(".drawer .conversation-item .conversation-title")].map(e => e.innerText); window.__initialOrder = o; return String(o.includes("{{A_SLUG}}") && o.includes("{{B_SLUG}}")); })(). 6. Call "poke" with timeout "40s" and no expect (it sends a message, so it must run once; it fails if no reply comes). 7. The order held within a bucket, or follows the buckets, read once as the old test did: eval WITHOUT expect (it runs once, and fails if it throws) of (async () => { const at = async id => (await (await fetch("/api/conversation/" + id)).json()).conversation.updated_at; const bucket = t => Math.floor(new Date(t).getTime() / 300000); const final = [...document.querySelectorAll(".drawer .conversation-item .conversation-title")].map(e => e.innerText); const initial = window.__initialOrder; const a = bucket(await at("{{A}}")), b = bucket(await at("{{B}}")); const fa = final.indexOf("{{A_SLUG}}"), fb = final.indexOf("{{B_SLUG}}"); if (a === b) { if (fa !== initial.indexOf("{{A_SLUG}}") || fb !== initial.indexOf("{{B_SLUG}}")) throw new Error("reordered: " + JSON.stringify(final)); return "held"; } if (!(a > b ? fa < fb : fb < fa)) throw new Error("not by bucket: " + JSON.stringify(final)); return "by bucket"; })().
